ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop (unsigned field) to drain extra tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop is not in SWAP_TYPEHASH but signer's limitAmount caps total input exposure. AMM enforces limitAmount at AMMModule.sol swap finalization. Known informational, below submission threshold per L-009.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Spoof executor context to settle orders with wrong recipient
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: PermitTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer() checks msg.sender != AMM at L115. Executor is the genuine swap caller, verified by AMM.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Replay CLOB order with different nonce context
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: closeOrder checks ptrOrder.maker != maker at CLOBHelper.sol:36. Nonces are monotonically incrementing via nextOrderNonce++.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Redirect fee to attacker address via hook configuration

ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _hashTypedDataV4 uses chain-specific domain separator with chainId at EIP712 constructor. PermitC domain is also chain-bound. Only destroyCosigner uses universal domain (known CP-002, Low).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Deploy ERC-1271 contract returning true for any hash to bypass signature checks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: The 'from' address is the ERC-1271 contract itself. Attacker would only drain their own tokens. No third-party victim.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Call afterSwapRefund callback directly to get credited without swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: afterSwapRefund checks msg.sender != AMM at CLOBTransferHandler.sol:316-318. Only AMM can call.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious permitProcessor that doesn't transfer tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM independently verifies balance increase at AMMModule.sol:2207-2210. Cannot fake transfer.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forge cross-module caller context to bypass access control
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All state-changing AMMStandardHook functions check _requireCallerIsAMM() at L940-943. Registry functions check _requireCallerIsRegistry() at L929-933.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reuse permit signature with different from address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 'from' is part of PermitC typehash. Changing from invalidates the signature.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill ratio manipulation to extract more than signer intended
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: FullMath.mulDiv rounds down (truncates), which REDUCES maxAmountIn, protecting signer. Worse execution gives lower maxAmountIn, tighter limit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB fill rounding exploitation via dust-loop (100+ tiny swaps)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: mulDivRoundingUp gives makers MORE output per fill step, hurting executor (attacker), not makers. Max leak is 2 wei per fill. Forge test confirms: 1000 fills of 1 wei each at price 2.25x leaks 750 wei to makers, from executor allocation.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cosigner nonce reuse to replay permit
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fill-or-kill uses REUSABLE_COSIGNATURE_NONCE=0 (cosignature reusable by design). But PermitC nonce tracking prevents the underlying permit transfer from being replayed. Partial fill uses cosignatureNonce which is consumed via bitmap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB callback data manipulation to redirect refund
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Handler constructs its own callback data at L288-293 (abi.encodeWithSelector). Executor cannot modify callback content.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence bug in pricing bounds (min | max == 0)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity resolves as (min | max) == 0 for uint160 types because uint160 | bool would be a type error. Forge test confirms correct behavior for all 4 input combinations.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious CLOB hook via initializeOrderBookKey to trap maker funds
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook only validates (revert or pass), doesn't control fund flow. Makers chose to place orders and can closeOrder to recover. Self-inflicted DoS at most.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill with amountOut=0 bypasses checks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: If amountOut=0, maxAmountIn = mulDiv(X, 0, Y) = 0. Any amountIn > 0 reverts with PartialFillExceedsMaximumInputForOutput.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious hook in permit (ITransferHandlerExecutorValidation) to steal funds
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook is signed by signer (hook address is in SWAP_TYPEHASH). Hook can only revert (DoS) or pass. Token transfer done by PermitC, not hook. Self-inflicted if malicious.

Exploit operator precedence bug in pricing bounds to bypass price protection
